questions.question: Who led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron?
What happened to Korah and his followers?
options: The earth opened and swallowed them
They were banished beyond the camp
They slipped away and were never found
They were pardoned after they repented
questions.answer: The earth opened and swallowed them

questions.question: Fire from the LORD also consumed the 250 men who offered incense.
The _____ opened its mouth and swallowed Korah and his household.
_____ led the rebellion, claiming the whole congregation was holy.
